witness.branch: Designated zone beside a paved shoulder
witness.quote: fail or refuse to comply with any signal
witness.reason: A paved shoulder can coexist with a supported travel route governed by a flagger in a designated zone.
required_context: Establish flagger authority, actual directions, visibility, route governance and temporary-zone designation.
Establish paved-shoulder geometry and a supported route alongside it.

Establish signal content, intended recipient, orientation, visibility, changes and release events alongside vehicle motion. Do not invent a response deadline or independently impose release-based timing.
Preserve flagger authorization and temporary-zone designation as administrative facts requiring independent support.
Record signal changes and any release alongside ego response.
Select a motor-powered motorcycle or moped satisfying vehicle scope and establish operator control.
Select a qualifying motor-powered vehicle and establish operator control without substituting an excluded electric scooter or human-powered device.
Verify paved-shoulder geometry and the motorcycle or moped route; do not infer that ego travels on the shoulder.
witness.subject_reason: A motor-powered motorcycle or moped operator controlling the configured qualifying vehicle is a driver; excluded electric scooters and human-powered devices are not substituted.
